There are 157 pay-to-play quests in Old School RuneScape, offering a total of 293 Quest points. Together with the free-to-play quests, there is a total of 181 quests for 339 Quest points.

Below is a list of all members-only quests. While the listed difficulties and lengths are the averages of each quest, these can still vary for every player. Some recommendations presented in quest guides may only represent a single point of view out of many possible strategies. Balance these walkthroughs with your own abilities and your knowledge of Old School RuneScape.
